question: How is immense material wealth contrasted with the value of the Kaula teaching?
premises: One might possess an ocean filled with jewels
This is set up as a comparison
inference: Even the accumulation of an ocean full of jewels is used as a measure inferior to the teaching's value.
uncertainties: The form akretuṃ is obscure and may be corrupt or highly compressed.
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation like an ocean filled with jewels...
